split_time_series_train_test_fraction: create a SimpleDataPartition with train_frac and test_frac to split time series data into train and test sets
split_time_series_train_test_size: create a SimpleDataPartition with train_size and test_size to split time series data by absolute number of data points
split_time_series_by_timestamp: create a SimpleTimestampDataPartition with train_end and test_start timestamps to split time series data by date ranges
split_time_series_rolling_origin: create a RollingOriginDataParition with start_train_frac and test_frac to perform rolling-origin cross-validation splits on time series data
split_multiple_time_series_parallel: create a SimpleDataPartition with multi=True to split multiple time series in parallel using multiprocessing across available CPU cores
